question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
solution:
The correct answer is "out."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The phrase **"reach out" **means to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something. (किसी चीज़ को छूने या पकड़ने के लिए हाथ फैलाना)

 
 
• **Example**:* She **reached out**__ to squeeze Hope's hand.*
 
 
 
• The paragraph conveys that she extended a single, long, white hand and twisted a finger as she saw Myna.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph:

Outside, the world had become a formless, __amorphous__ with no shape, while the house itself seemed to have twisted and stretched. There was sticky web-stuff __clung__ to her arm, and she wiped it off as best as she could. The other mother was waiting for her, standing on the grass with her arms __folded__. Her black button eyes were expressionless, but her lips were pressed tightly in a cold __fury__. When she saw Myna she reached __**out**__ one long white hand, and she crooked a finger.
